{{Quote|I just hope they save us a piece of birthday honey-cake, ''Wicket!''<nowiki />|Teebo|<ref name="e2" />}}
'''Honey-cake''' was a type of [[Birthday cake/Legends|birthday cake]] made with [[Honey/Legends|honey]] that was [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]].<ref name="e2" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="E2Date">{{InsiderCite|23|Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline}} dates the events of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which include the events of [[Ewoks (1985) 2|''Ewoks'' 2]], to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Cake/Legends|cake]] was served at the [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]] party of the Ewok [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], which was held in [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. [[Gender/Legends|Her]] friend [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] mentioned to another friend, [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]], that he hoped a slice would be saved for the latter two of them when they returned to the village.<ref name="e2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Honey-cake was mentioned in the [[Ewoks (1985) 2|second issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which was written by [[David Manak]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]]<ref name="e2" /> on [[April 2]], [[1985]].<ref name="Age">{{BookCite|title=[[Marvel Age]]|number=Vol. 1 No. 27|publisher=[[Marvel Comics]] Group|date=[[June]] [[1985]]}}</ref>
